producer_report.summary: Added the auditor role, modelled on the audience role. It has a fixed prompt constant and a typed report, a core module that runs it, and an `athena audit` command. The prompt tells it to judge outcomes against BRIEF.md and the owner's goals. Its brief carries BRIEF.md and no job acceptance criteria. A finding with no evidence is rejected and records nothing. Protection of the prompt is marked prose-only until the warden lands. CHANGELOG.md, docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md and docs/records.md are updated. Full `cargo test --locked` has 1 failure: drain::a_change_to_max_concurrency_alone_does_not_invalidate_a_reading. It fails because athena.toml already has max_concurrency = 1, so the test's two replace() calls (2→1 and 2→3) change nothing and its assert_ne!(before, after) fails. That is a flaw in the test and athena.toml, not in this change, and I cannot edit athena.toml. I did not run it on the base commit; the reasoning comes from reading the test and athena.toml. With that one test skipped, every other test passes: 254 in athena-core, the 5 new ones in tests/auditor.rs, and all the other workspace suites.

checks_run.note: Run to completion with --no-fail-fast. The only failure is drain::a_change_to_max_concurrency_alone_does_not_invalidate_a_reading, which does not touch the auditor. athena.toml has max_concurrency = 1, so the test's before and after configs come out equal and assert_ne! fails. I did not confirm on the base commit. Rerunning with that one test skipped passes everything else: athena-core 254 passed, tests/auditor.rs 5 passed, drain 70 passed, lifecycle 43 passed.
5 passed: records a typed finding, brief has BRIEF.md and no acceptance criteria, evidence-less finding rejected, no brief means no model call, nested run records nothing, command exists.
254 passed, including auditor::tests::a_report_becomes_a_record_only_when_every_finding_cites_evidence and the brief test.

The full `cargo test --locked` has one failure, drain a_change_to_max_concurrency_alone_does_not_invalidate_a_reading. It is a test and athena.toml mismatch (max_concurrency is already 1), not caused by this change, and a governance file cannot be edited. With that test skipped, the whole workspace passes.
